chunks: Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab, from al-Hasan ibn Musa al-Khashshab, from 'Ali ibn Asbat, from some of his companions, from Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام and Abu Ja'far عليه السلام, concerning:
A man is behind the Imam, not following him in اقتداء, and the Imam gets ahead of him in the recitation. He said: If he has already recited Umm al-Kitab, that suffices for him, and he stops and bows.

key_terms.بِالْقِرَاءَةِ: in the recitation of the prayer
key_terms.لَا يَقْتَدِي بِهِ: he does not follow him as the prayer leader

ai.seo_question: If someone is praying behind an Imam whom he does not follow and the Imam finishes recitation first, what should he do?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about one praying behind an Imam whom he does not follow in اقتداء. If the person has already recited Umm al-Kitab and the Imam advances ahead in recitation, his recitation is sufficient, and he should discontinue and proceed to ruku'.
